panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Frontal clinical photograph showing classic craniofacial features of Hallermann-Streiff syndrome including bird-like facies, micrognathia, small mouth, sparse hair, and facial skin changes as described in the caption. B: Profile clinical photograph demonstrating craniofacial profile abnormalities consistent with Hallermann-Streiff syndrome. C: Intraoral clinical photograph showing dental defects characteristic of Hallermann-Streiff syndrome including malformed teeth, dental prosthesis, partial anodontia, anterior open bite, and discolored teeth.

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Frontal 3D reconstruction displays characteristic bird-like facies with severe mandibular hypoplasia, retrognathia, and dental anomalies consistent with Hallermann-Streiff syndrome. B: Profile 3D reconstruction confirms retrognathia and midface hypoplasia, key manifestations of Hallermann-Streiff syndrome. C: Axial CT scan demonstrates prominent deviation of the nasal septum, a documented craniofacial manifestation of Hallermann-Streiff syndrome in this patient.
panels.attribution_text: Shen et al. Hallermann-Streiff syndrome with uncommon ocular features, ultrasound biomicroscopy and optical coherence tomography findings: A case report.. Medicine 2019. doi:10.1097/md.0000000000018272. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 3.
panels.figure_caption: 3D reconstructed images of the face showing mandibular deficiency, anodontia and hypoplastic midface with a retrognathic pattern. (A) Full face; (B) Profile. (C) Computer tomography showing a prominent deviation of the nasal septum.
in_text_mentions: Multi slice computer tomography (MSCT) reconstruction revealed a disproportion between the large cranial vault and the small facial skeleton. The facial skeleton was characterized by a marked posterosuperior positioning of the maxillomandibular complex. Most striking was mandibular deficiency. The ascending ramus and body of the mandible were severely underdeveloped. The prominent deviation of nasal septum was found. Odontogenic anomalies consisting of anodontia in incisor teeth and hypoplastic teeth were also found (Fig. 3).
